items: Stand up a local Kafka broker and create topics.
Build a producer that publishes events to a topic.
Build consumers that join a consumer group for parallel processing.
Observe partition rebalancing and delivery semantics.
Architect a small streaming app (e.g., order events → enrichment → analytics).
Topic — a named, partitioned, replicated log of events.
Producer — publishes messages with a key (controls partition) to a topic.
Consumer group — a set of consumers sharing the load; each partition is read by one group member.
Partition / Offset — units of parallelism and position within a topic.
Delivery semantics — at-most-once, at-least-once, exactly-once.

blocks.text: Build an "Order Processing" streaming pipeline: an Orders producer emits OrderCreated events; a consumer group enriches them and republishes OrderEnriched to a second topic; an analytics consumer counts orders per region.
Kafka brokers hold topics orders and orders.enriched. Two consumer groups (enrich and analytics) read independently. Scaling consumers within a group scales partition consumption.

items: Docker + Docker Compose.
Python 3.10+ with kafka-python, or Node.js with kafkajs.
kafka-console-producer/consumer (via bitnami/kafka image) available.

blocks.value:
services:
  kafka:
    image: bitnami/kafka:latest
    ports: ["9092:9092"]
    environment:
      KAFKA_CFG_LISTENERS: PLAINTEXT://:9092
      KAFKA_CFG_ADVERTISED_LISTENERS: PLAINTEXT://localhost:9092
      KAFKA_CFG_AUTO_CREATE_TOPICS_ENABLE: "false"

docker exec -it <kafka> kafka-topics.sh --create --topic orders --partitions 3 --replication-factor 1 --bootstrap-server localhost:9092
docker exec -it <kafka> kafka-topics.sh --create --topic orders.enriched --partitions 3 --replication-factor 1 --bootstrap-server localhost:9092

blocks.text: Write a producer that sends 100 OrderCreated events with region as the message key (so same region → same partition).
Build a consumer in group enrich that reads orders, adds a timestamp and total, and publishes to orders.enriched. Run two instances to see partition rebalancing.
Build a consumer in group analytics reading orders.enriched that prints a running count of orders per region every 10 seconds.

blocks.value:
flowchart LR
    P[Producer: Orders] -->|OrderCreated| T1[(Topic: orders)]
    T1 --> CG1[Consumer Group: enrich]
    CG1 -->|OrderEnriched| T2[(Topic: orders.enriched)]
    T2 --> CG2[Consumer Group: analytics]
    CG2 --> D[(Dashboard / Counts)]

items: Running Kafka with both topics created (show kafka-topics --list output).
Producer + two consumer groups functioning; demonstrate rebalancing by stopping one enrich consumer.
A short report showing order counts per region from the analytics consumer.
Bonus: configure enable.idempotence=true on the producer and explain exactly-once vs at-least-once.
